_note: Starting warehouse state. This used to be a dict literal in tools.py, which meant inventory reset every launch while processed_ids.txt kept persisting. It now lives on disk so both halves of the agent's state survive a restart. This file is the committed seed and is never written to: on first run tools.load_warehouse() copies it to warehouse.json (gitignored), and all mutations go there. Delete warehouse.json to reset the demo. JSON has no comment syntax, so this note is a key -- load_warehouse() drops any key starting with an underscore.
